reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000135 (the melody read from 000135a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Louis M. Gottschalk's dates (1829–1869) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Moreau_Gottschalk; CCEH's page gives only the year 1854. Edwin P. Parker's dates (1836–1920) are from https://viaf.org/viaf/19349299 (Parker, Edwin Pond, 1836-1920); https://www.hymnwiki.org/Edwin_Pond_Parker (arranger of MERCY from Gottschalk); CCEH's page gives only the year 1880.
